A.O. No. 22 of 2016
Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Mr. Yogesh Pacholia, counsel for the appellant/claimants.
Mr. D.N. Sharma, counsel for respondent no.1.
Mr. Siddhartha Bisht, counsel for respondent 
no.2/Insurance Company.
2. Counsel for the appellant/claimants would submit that the 
Tribunal has inadvertently and mistakenly has assessed the 
compensation by applying the multiplier on monthly income in 
place of the annual income of the deceased. 
3. Counsel for respondent nos. 1 & 2 does not oppose the said 
submissions.
4. This Court thinks that it would be appropriate for the 
parties if the matter be sent for Mediation.
5. The counsel for the parties are agreed for the same.
6. In view of the above, the parties are directed to appear in 
person before the Registrar (Protocol) Mediation Centre of this 
Court for Mediation on 06.11.2023 at 3.00 P.M. who shall submit 
report before this Court within two weeks.
7. The Regional Manager, National Insurance Company, 
Regional Office, Haldwani District Nainital shall appear on behalf 
of the Insurance Company before Mediation Centre on the date 
fixed for Mediation. 
8. Put up this case on 05.12.2023.
9. Counsel for the parties shall inform the parties to the 
proceedings accordingly. 
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) 16.10.2023 Mamta
